offering_description.value: Leases commercial aircraft engines, aircraft and related equipment to airlines, and sells engines and parts. Also sells used serviceable material and provides engine management and maintenance services. Owns the engines and manages them across their lifecycle.

primary_products.value: leased jet engines; leased aircraft; used serviceable engine parts; engine sales

primary_services.value: engine leasing; engine lifecycle asset management; maintenance and repair management; engine and aircraft trading

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial airlines, cargo operators, aircraft and engine owners, MROs and lessors

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; air cargo; regional aviation; aircraft maintenance

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: lease rent and maintenance reserves from engines and aircraft on operating leases; product sales: sales of engines, aircraft and used serviceable parts; service fees: engine management and maintenance services
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: buys and owns aircraft engines and aircraft, leases them to airlines; distributor: sells used serviceable material and parts from disassembled engines to operators and MROs

geography_served.value: global: Airlines and operators worldwide, with offices in the US, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: engine leasing, aircraft leasing, spare parts sales and maintenance services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct negotiation with airlines and operators for leases and sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aviation airworthiness rules from FAA and EASA, export controls, sanctions and trade rules
